Loss report: tekton -> gitlab
[lost] pipeline/.shared display.name (GitLab CI has no display name here; the name is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/.shared ext.passthrough (the pipeline has no trigger GitLab can express; workflow:rules never starts it)
[lost] pipeline/.shared/job/run ext.passthrough (Ext of provider tekton (task_name) is not written to the GitLab file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/.shared/job/run job.if (pipeline .shared has no trigger GitLab can express; job disabled)
[lost] pipeline/ci display.name (GitLab CI has no display name here; the name is kept in round-trip metadata)
[emulated] pipeline/ci project.multi_pipeline: jobs of every pipeline in one file under <pipeline>:<job> keys (each job carries its pipeline's trigger condition and a marker; workflow:rules is the union of all triggers)
